key_insight: PADSNet combines visual features with explicit vocal-fold biomechanics to classify laryngeal lesions.
clinical_relevance: Vocal-fold motion may provide complementary clues when lesion types have subtle visual differences.
method: Wavelet attention combines spatial texture and dynamic frequency representations.
A knowledge module extracts mobility, symmetry, glottal closure, and vibration stability indices.
Physics-aware gating uses these biomechanical priors to recalibrate visual features.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on a clinical dataset reported 84.52% accuracy, 80.90% F1-score, 79.53% sensitivity, and 88.66% specificity.
watch_item: The abstract does not report dataset size or external validation, leaving generalizability uncertain.
paper_title: PADSNet: Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network with Biomechanical Priors for Laryngeal Lesion Classification
